crossRefs.note: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
For who has stood in the council of Yahweh, that he should perceive and hear his word? Who has listened to my word, and…
“For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

translations.web: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
translations.bsb: “Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His counselor?”
translations.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
translations.asv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
